subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR accept runtime stale-registry invalidation for explicit `orphan-source-path` diagnostics and legacy no-code missing-source diagnostics, or should the legacy cleanup move to doctor/migration-owned code before merge?
rationale: The code repair is concrete, but the legacy branch changes upgrade behavior for persisted SQLite registry state and repository policy treats persisted state and startup fallback behavior as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept Targeted Runtime Invalidation
options.body: Merge the explicit-marker and schema fix with the legacy no-code runtime branch as a bounded startup recovery path for upgraded users.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup To Doctor
options.body: Keep the explicit marker and schema persistence but move pre-code SQLite row repair out of the steady-state runtime path.

recommendation.title: Accept Targeted Runtime Invalidation
recommendation.body: Merge the explicit-marker and schema fix with the legacy no-code runtime branch as a bounded startup recovery path for upgraded users.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc gave the prior explicit-marker direction on the predecessor and recently maintained the affected plugin registry files.
